ITEM 1 | Pizza slice at upper right, golden-brown crust with bubbly edge, red tomato sauce base, melted pale cheese, scattered diced yellow pieces (likely pepper or corn) and dark crumbled meat chunks, roughly 12 cm long wedge, about 1.5 cm thick at crust | 110
ITEM 2 | Mixed salad greens on left-center of plate, dark and light green leaves with some purple-red edges, fresh and slightly glossy, piled about 8 cm across and 2 cm high | 45
ITEM 3 | Bean sprouts and shredded pale yellow strands (likely julienned vegetable) at left edge, crisp and pale, forming a loose mound about 4 cm across | 15
ITEM 4 | Single cherry tomato half-visible, bright red, smooth glossy skin, about 2.5 cm diameter, sitting among the greens | 12
ITEM 5 | Brown cooked meat piece at lower right of plate, dark reddish-brown with a crusty sesame-seeded coating, slightly glazed and sheen, about 6 cm by 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting beside the greens | 60
ITEM 6 | Small scattered yellow diced pieces at left of greens, bright yellow, firm cubes about 0.5 cm, matte surface | 3
